articles.title: Israel launches fresh strikes on Lebanon despite Trump criticism
articles.description: Speaking on Tuesday, Trump said Israel's PM Benjamin Netanyahu needed "to be more responsible with respect to Lebanon".

articles.title: UK investigating reports Russian warship fired warning shots near yacht in English Channel
articles.description: The retired couple tell BBC Newsnight they tried to show the warship they had changed course in the English Channel before the shots were fired.

articles.title: Group planned to attack White House UFC event using snipers and drones, FBI says
articles.description: In newly unsealed court filings, the government says the group allegedly expressed grievances about corruption, the Epstein files, and data centres.

articles.title: The bikers battling extreme heat and armed conflict to smuggle Iranian fuel to Pakistan
articles.description: It's so hot the fuel can catch fire - the bikers tell the BBC they must live with the risk of injury and death.

articles.title: What we know about Russian warship that fired warning shots in English Channel
articles.description: A Russia warship fired warning shots at a UK-registered yacht in the English Channel in an incident that has intensified national security concerns.
